doc.title: Steve Turré interviewed by Monk Rowe, via Zoom, November 29, 2021

chapter: Studio work, recordings and Saturday Night Live
title: Listening to his own recordings
summary: He mostly avoids hearing himself but can live with a few records.

story.theme_name: In the studio: making records, then and now
story.community_name: Record labels, producers and the business of making albums

blocks.x: Do you feel you play, well I’m going to rephrase my question. Do you enjoy listening to the recordings, either your own or the recordings that you’re on as a sideman?

Some of them. Some of them I don’t, but I always feel like man I don’t want to hear that. I hear my flaws and I know what my strengths and weaknesses are. We all have them. You know naturally when I don’t hear something come out the way I’d like it to it bothers me. So I don’t usually listen to myself you know. But there are a few records and a few cuts on various records that I say okay, I can live with that.
